property_summary: For any actor and any positive deposit, consecutive calls to withdrawAll() must all succeed (repeated withdrawals are idempotent no-ops); the mutant's never-cleared reentrancy lock makes every withdrawAll() after the first revert, breaking this for some input.
change_summary: Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = false;` after the `_` so the lock stays set forever, making any second withdrawAll call revert.
